hypothesis: A 4-parameter learned selective-forgetting gate that suppresses forgetting quadratically for low observed action-prediction contradictions can adapt to hidden causal changes while preserving stable-world factual memory, unlike P90's unprotected contradiction-conditioned gate.

source.generator: P86 reference pure counter-SHA256 indexed exact dyadic 16D continuous action→effect hidden rank4 world with two independent causal matrices. Each source family independently generates 48 confirmed executed action/effect observations then unseen 49th action with effect withheld. Half worlds change mapping after t24, half remain unchanged. No P90 FIT/VAL source reuse; A/B SHA256 checked independently on Windows and Linux. Do not generate reserved OOD/NEGATIVE.
source.audit: No query consequence in inputs, query not equal to prior action, all finite, exact half stable/changed per family; no step index/regime/current effect accessible to controller; observed-only updates.

controllers.state: Exactly one 16x16 256-float per-world W. key=normalize(raw observed action); before every confirmed update predict W@key, residual=observed effect - prediction. On query t48 predict but never update.
controllers.fixed: P86 CAL-frozen eta=1, decay=.99, 0 trained parameters.
controllers.constant: 2 trainable global scalars b_eta,b_forget: eta=2sigmoid(b_eta), forget=.2sigmoid(b_forget), W←(1-forget)W+eta*residual*k^T.
controllers.contradiction: 4 trainable global scalars b_eta,b_forget,s_eta,s_forget; f=RMS(residual)/(RMS(residual)+.1). eta=2sigmoid(b_eta+s_eta*f), forget=.2sigmoid(b_forget+s_forget*f). Identical to P90 controlled branch but new P91 FIT/VAL source and independent global model initializations.
controllers.observation: 4 trainable global scalars with identical parameterization but feature RMS(observed effect)/(RMS(observed effect)+.1).
controllers.protected: 4 trainable global scalars, SAME eta as contradiction but forget=.2sigmoid(b_forget+s_forget*f)*f*f, f from genuine residual; structural guaranteed low-error forgetting suppression. Does not use oracle change/phase/time; no additional per-world state.

training.paired_batches: Every arm and seed uses exactly same FIT index sequence drawn from concatenated 2 family FIT; initial b_eta/b_forget matched across all arms per seed; four-param slopes initially 0.
training.objective: Mean prequential MSE queries 32..48; checkpoint selection based on arithmetic mean across A and B VAL final query MSE. Report each family stable/changed/late final, early/late retention and adaptation windows, all eight validation checkpoints. No change of protocol after viewing outcomes.

controls.source: Each FIT/VAL family has independent byte SHA and shape/withheld label audits; P90/P86 Git blob custody and exact fixed 256 W parity PASS. Bitwise 256-float fast-state cold restore for every arm including trained selected logits.
controls.competence: P86 CAL locked fixed raw W256 VAL stable and changed each <=.80*zero on both A,B, and within-family rotated historical effect wrong-credit MSE >=1.5x fixed and >=.01.
controls.negative: Wrong-credit control uses VAL histories only with rotated past 48 effects, does not consume reserved NEGATIVE source.
controls.retention: On stable worlds compare mean online prequential MSE t32..48 after observations 0..31 vs fixed; report change-world early post-change t24..31 vs late t40..48. Stability retention gate: protected stable-world late t32..48 <=1.05x fixed late on each VAL family and each seed.
controls.no_science_first_use: Reserved unfamiliar OOD and separate negative source functions do not exist in study; no new science evaluation.

acceptance.baseline: All three newly trained constant baselines must beat 0.90× zero VAL final on both A and B, have selected checkpoint <=70 and final two checkpoints <=1.05× selected best. Otherwise baseline unqualified.
acceptance.protected: ALL 3 seeds AND BOTH independent VAL families: protected final combined <=.90× fixed, <=.90× newly trained constant and <=.90× newly trained P90-contradiction; stable final <=1.05× fixed stable; changed final <=.85× fixed changed; stable late32..48 <=1.05× fixed stable late; selected step <=70; final two overall checkpoints <=1.05× selected overall best. If any fail label DEV_FAIL and keep reserved sources untouched.
acceptance.decision: Even full 2-family synthetic VAL PASS only DEV_PASS_CANDIDATE not SCIENTIFIC_PASS; independent cold unfamiliar heldout and matched end-to-end model/compute qualification separately authorized. If fail, no post-result tuning or changed frozen thresholds.
